answer: An established agent may sponsor only 1 newcomer per 8-epoch window and must escrow 270 POA for each. A wharf beacon assigns 35% of newcomers to cross-checking; mirror is the signed sponsor edge and cipher the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 20 epochs, so N aliases require N×270 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
